title: TICKER
text:
Multiplayer stock-market board game (Vietnamese name: Cờ chứng khoán).
Share a room code, take a seat, and trade until one fund remains. No accounts.
Play: tickergame.vercel.app
Tutorial: tickergame.vercel.app/tutorial
itch.io: comrade-lenan.itch.io/ticker



TICKER cover





TICKER banner







TICKER game board


The green felt board has company tiles, ETF rings, and corners for START, SEC, and WEEKEND. Dice sit in the center. Price Reaction and Market News decks sit beside the eight-sector market track.



TICKER lobby


Create a room, share the short code, pick a fund seat, and play in English or Vietnamese. You can also watch computer-controlled funds.



Company deed card





Trade buy moment





Price Reaction card





Market News card






Next.js App Router for the board UI
Cloudflare PartyServer with one Durable Object per room
Rulebook: MARKETPOLY_RULEBOOK_V5.md




src/
  app/           Routes
  components/    Board, cards, FX, HUD, room, shell
  content/       Company, news, and PR decks
  lib/game/      Engine, bots, balance harness
  lib/fx/        Peg, cash, and card choreography
  shared/        Protocol and GameState
party/           PartyServer worker
docs/rulebook/   Shipped V5 rules
docs/archive/    Historical drafts
scripts/         Balance and fund-matrix CLIs
public/press/    Cover, banner, and screenshots



npm install
cp .env.example .env.local
npm run dev:all
Set NEXT_PUBLIC_PARTY_HOST=localhost:8888 in .env.local.

Next.js: http://localhost:3010
PartyServer: port 8888

You start in the room lobby as a spectator, then join a seat. If you leave mid-game, that seat keeps autoplaying.



npm test
npm run balance:sim -- --scenario standard2 --games 200
npm run balance:funds -- --games 12
npm run balance:audit -- --games 600 --fundGames 14






Piece
Host
Production




Frontend
Vercel
https://tickergame.vercel.app


Realtime
Cloudflare Workers
https://ticker.letrinhan123.workers.dev



npm run party:deploy
npx vercel deploy --prod
On Vercel, set NEXT_PUBLIC_PARTY_HOST to ticker.letrinhan123.workers.dev.



The live multiplayer table stays on Vercel and Cloudflare. The itch page is a branded HTML wrapper that opens that build.

Create the game at itch.io/game/new with URL slug ticker under account comrade-lenan.
Install butler once: npm run itch:setup
Export your API key (never commit it): export ITCH_API_KEY=your_key
Deploy: npm run itch:deploy

Default target is comrade-lenan/ticker:html. Override with ITCH_TARGET if needed. Cover art is at itch/cover.jpg and public/brand/ticker-cover.jpg.

title: Retro Typewriter Cyberdeck
text:
A self-contained portable computing unit built around the Raspberry Pi 5, housed in a repurposed decorative wooden chest. Designed and assembled in London, winter 2024/2025.



Front





Fully portable: battery-backed, no dependency on mains power
Self-contained: display, input, compute, and networking in one enclosure
Dual-purpose: general-purpose Linux workstation and passive 802.11 network monitoring via Pwnagotchi co-processor
No 3D printing, no CNC: enclosure repurposed from off-the-shelf hardware













Component
Specification
Source
Unit Price




SBC
Raspberry Pi 5, 4GB

GeeekPi 7” IPS LCD, 1024x600, 60Hz, 500 cd/m2, HDMI

AliExpress

AliExpress
£18.87


Battery cells

-
TBD



Total (confirmed components): ~£256.41 + $18.79 + batteries





Raspberry Pi 5 (4GB LPDDR4X) running Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. The active cooler is fitted directly to the SoC heatspreader and routed to exhaust through a ventilation gap at the rear of the enclosure.



The Waveshare UPS HAT (E) is stacked directly on the GPIO header via Pogo Pins, supplying 5V/6A to the Pi. Two 18650 Li-ion cells (4200mAh each, ~31Wh combined at nominal voltage) are housed in the HAT’s integrated battery bay. The HAT supports hot-swap charging: the system remains operational while charging via USB-C. Known issue: battery percentage readout is unreliable under Ubuntu; the HAT reports via I2C but driver support is incomplete.



The GeeekPi 7” IPS panel is mounted externally on the inner face of the lid, connected via a coiled Micro HDMI cable routed through the hinge gap. The coil accommodates lid open/close movement without cable stress. Resolution set to 1024x600 at 60Hz; display is powered directly from the HDMI port.



IDOBAO ID42 40% hotswap mechanical keyboard, fitted with Kailh Box Navy tactile-clicky switches and IDOBAO white keycaps. The 40% layout reduces footprint while retaining full alphanumeric coverage via layers. The keyboard sits external to the enclosure and connects via USB.



The Pi’s onboard BCM43455 handles primary wireless. A secondary USB Wi-Fi adapter extends range. The Pwnagotchi co-processor runs on a dedicated microcontroller with its own 2.13” e-ink status display, performing passive 802.11 handshake capture and AI-driven interaction loop independent of the main OS.



The upper compartment houses the main board stack (Pi 5, UPS HAT, cooler) and battery cells, with styrofoam-carved dividers holding each component in a fixed position to prevent movement under transport. The lower compartment is left open as a carry space for peripheral gadgets: Pwnagotchi, cables, USB adapters, or anything else in rotation. The wooden chest provides adequate rigidity and incidental EMF containment without requiring any machining.

title: Rafetus
text:
Turn your document collection into a knowledge library you can explore with AI. With Rafetus you can store, read, search, and ask questions about your documents in one app.



Rafetus icon


Product: rafetus.vn
App Store: Rafetus - AI Document Manager
Web sign-in: auth.rafetus.vn



Ask AI





Central document library — Store PDF and DOCX files, organize them in folders, and tag them for easy management.
Smart search — Find information across documents and notes quickly without rereading everything.
Ask AI (Rafai) — Ask questions and get answers grounded in your own document content, with cited sources.
Read and annotate — Highlight key passages, select text, and ask AI to explain difficult sections.
Knowledge connections — Build an AI knowledge graph that links documents and notes so you can discover useful relationships.




AI library





Deep search





Reader selection





Eight short steps from the Rafetus tutorial:



Upload documents to your library (PDF and files ready for search and AI).
Tag your documents so you can find them again.





Read and ask AI on the page — select passages, mark what matters.
Deep search — find related content even without exact keywords.





Ask AI across many documents with clear source citations.
Choose sources when asking AI so answers stay focused.





Explore the knowledge network — visualize documents, notes, and relations.
Link notes to build your own knowledge network step by step.




Library tags





Library folders





Knowledge graph






From rafetus.vn/ai:

Connect related information across notes and documents.
Select relevant context for each question instead of searching manually.
Stay in control — choose which data AI can use; turn the feature off anytime.
Conversations are not used to train models under Rafetus policy (Privacy).




Thinking Without Limits — connecting knowledge in a unified space with artificial intelligence.
Core values (from About):

User-centric experience — simplify upload → organize → explore.
Substantive tech — optimize data architecture and core algorithms.
Accumulating knowledge — a foundation for long-term intellectual legacy.
Absolute knowledge sovereignty — your documents stay yours.
Continuous evolution — product and platform keep moving with user needs.

Founding team: Lê Trí Nhân (Administration & Lead Engineer), Hồ Văn Thạnh (Technical Administration & Data).
